# Vortex Dispatch

> Vortex Dispatch is a commercial software studio in Cape Town, South Africa. We design, build, and run production web software for businesses — booking platforms, marketplaces, compliance tooling, and AI-assisted delivery systems. We are not a transport, trucking, or fleet-dispatch service; the name refers to how work is dispatched through our build pipeline.

Canonical site: https://vortexdispatch.co.za
Contact: hello@vortexdispatch.co.za
Location: Cape Town, South Africa
Founded: 2024

## What we do

- Custom web application development: customer-facing platforms and the operational software behind them
- Booking systems with payments (Paystack, PayFast)
- Marketplaces and staffing platforms
- Compliance and document-generation products (POPIA-aware)
- Ongoing hosting, monitoring, and iteration — we run what we ship
- Engineering standard: architecture first, automated tests leading every build, review gates before ship

## Live products we built and run

- [Mini Suites](https://minisuites.co.za): booking platform for a luxury short-stay rental — live and taking paid bookings through Paystack
- [ShiftSavvy](https://shiftsavvy.co.za): same-shift staffing marketplace for restaurants — production PWA with a 109-test suite
- [FoundersDesk](https://foundersdesk.co.za): paid company document pack covering 11 South African legal and compliance documents
- [ReturnReady](https://returnready-black.vercel.app): SARS filing-season co-pilot — client-side rules engine, 70 automated tests, no tax data leaves the browser
- [SpeedReading](https://speedreading.playfulskills.co.za): interactive speed-reading trainer with progressive WPM tiers
- [Sovereign Breath](https://breath.playfulskills.co.za): offline-first breathwork PWA

## Engagement

Fixed quote per scoped build, in South African rand, after a free discovery conversation. Ongoing run-and-maintain support as a monthly retainer. Start by emailing hello@vortexdispatch.co.za.
